description: This file defines classes and functions for configuring and controlling PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) signals in a firmware project, including the PwmConfig and SimplePwm classes, callback types, and related functions.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Class representing multi-channel software PWM output configuration, including parameters for frequency, mode, output pins, and callbacks.

classes.name: SimplePwm
classes.description: Derived class from PwmConfig for simple PWM with fixed duty cycle and specific pin configuration.

methods.name: PwmConfig
methods.description: Constructor initializing PwmConfig with switch times and wave data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes PwmConfig with switch times and wave data.

methods.name: weComplexInit
methods.description: Performs complex initialization with message, executor, phase count, switch times, wave count, pin states, and callbacks.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets PWM frequency; NAN value pauses PWM.
